title: Lighthouse Finance — Account Journal & Outreach Play
content:
Quick notes + play for Lighthouse Finance (mid-market payments/SMB lending platform).

Snapshot:
- HQ: Boston (~400 employees).
- Product: payments + underwriting for SMBs; heavy transactional volume, compliance sensitivity (PCI, SOC2).
- Priorities: reduce cost-per-transaction, speed up dispute resolution (automated Q&A for support), protect PII, meet EU data residency for EU merchants.
- Current stack notes (from public app + job posts): Python backend (FastAPI), Kafka event streams, Postgres, Azure + some GCP presence, uses Redis for session/cache.

Key contacts (to reach/confirm):
- Priya Nair, Head of Platform (priya.nair@lighthousef.com) — technical champion candidate.
- Marcus Lowe, Dir of Product (marcus.lowe@lighthousef.com) — cares about latency & SLAs.
- Sarah Gomez, Head of Support Ops — interested in answers automation / quality control.
- Legal/compliance: TBD (ask for SOC/KMS contact).

Pain & positioning hypothesis:
- Pain: inference cost at scale for support/autoresponders; latency spikes during peak payroll cycles; data residency obligations in EU; internal ops teams lack simple runbooks for model regressions.
- Redwood fit: Dedicated capacity + VPC (predictable throughput + data isolation) or Private on-prem for EU tenants; Optimize tooling to reduce token cost via batching/caching; Console's per-route breakdown to measure unit economics at token-level.

Suggested GTM pitch (30s):
- "We help teams like yours run LLM features at production scale with predictable latency and cost. You can route high-value requests to dedicated capacity or keep sensitive EU traffic private — while getting tooling to cut token spend and catch quality regressions before customers do."

Outbound/email draft (short — subject + body):
- Subject: Quick idea to cut LLM costs & improve support SLAs at Lighthouse

- Hi Priya —
  Saw Lighthouse’s recent expansion into EU merchants. We’ve been working with similar payments platforms to reduce per-transaction LLM spend while keeping sub-200ms median latency for support prompts.
  Would you be open to a 20 min sync to walk through a lightweight pilot (no code change required on your side) to validate cost and latency gains? I can bring a short plan tailored to your compliance needs (VPC/private routing).

  Cheers,
  Maya Chen

Call agenda (20 min):
- 0–3m quick intros & high-level problem framing
- 3–8m current stack & constraints (ask: throughput, peak QPS, latency SLOs, EU data residency scope)
- 8–12m short demo/walkthrough of Redwood routing & Dedicated options (screenshots + cost model)
- 12–17m proposed pilot + instrumentation (control group, metrics)
- 17–20m next steps / legal / timelines

Pilot idea (4–6 weeks):
- Scope: support auto-responses for 3 high-volume categories (chargebacks, refunds, onboarding questions)
- Traffic slice: 5–10% of production routed to Redwood Dedicated (can be burstable) or hosted with VPC egress for EU.
- Success metrics: >=30% reduction in token cost per resolved ticket OR 20% faster median time-to-first-response; error rate (hallucinations) <0.5% on sampled evals.
- Instrumentation: console dashboards (per-route latency + token spend), snapshot eval harness tied to selected prompt sets.

Technical notes / integration options (to pass to Priya):
- Fast path: REST API + SDK integration — minimal code changes: swap endpoint for support microservice; use streaming for UI.
- VPC/Private: private control plane + on-prem package available for EU region (discuss certs/KMS).
- Auth: API keys or mTLS for Dedicated; recommend short-lived keys + rotation policy.
- Data handling: prefix/KV caching recommended for FAQ templates; redact PIIs before send (we should offer snippet for client-side pre-processing).
- Example call (pseudo):
  POST /v1/generate
  Headers: Authorization: Bearer <key>
  Body: {"model":"rw-augmented-1", "input":"{ticket_text}", "stream":true, "metadata":{"tenant":"lighthouse-eu"}}

Objections + suggested responses (concise):
- "We can’t send PII to hosted services": Offer Private deployment or VPC + guaranteed EU region processing; show SOC2 / KMS integrations and data flow diagram.
- "Cost is unpredictable": Pitch Dedicated reserved capacity with predictable unit economics and Optimize recommendations for caching/quantization. Provide sample cost model using their QPS (run quick calc in call).
- "We already have in-house models": Ask about TCO (ops, SRE, infra scaling). Emphasize maintenance + kernel/quantization work and smaller headcount to keep latency SLOs at scale. Offer a side-by-side perf/cost comparison as a follow-up.
- "Latency spikes at peak": Highlight smart routing (burst to higher-cost low-latency pool + fallback) + autoscaling policies and cache warming techniques.

Evaluation & data collection plan:
- Baseline week: collect token usage, latency P50/P95, number of escalations from support flows.
- Pilot weeks: capture same metrics + human evals on 500 random resolved tickets for hallucination/accuracy.
- Reporting cadence: weekly snapshot + final postmortem with dashboard views.

Commercial ask (initial):
- 6-week proof-of-value: discounted reserved capacity + free onboarding support from Solutions Eng (max 40 hrs).
- Post-pilot: option to convert to 6–12 month Dedicated contract or switch to Private for EU-only flows.

Open questions (to research before call):
- Confirm exact EU data residency requirements (all merchants vs subset).
- Verify QPS numbers for support microservice (avg & peaks).
- Does Lighthouse use an existing KMS (Azure Key Vault / AWS KMS) we can integrate?
- Who owns legal review / security questionnaire turnaround time?

Notes to self (prep checklist):
- Pull 2 pager with screenshots of Console routing UI & per-route cost breakdown.
- Mock cost calc for 100k tokens/day vs 1M tokens/day (shared slide).
- Draft narrow prompt set for pilot (work with Evan for test prompts).
- Save an anonymized sample of support tickets to show typical prompt length.

Next steps & owners:
- Email intro to Priya (Maya) — target week of Jan 19.
- Pre-call research: Evan to confirm typical token lengths + Rina to draft security snippet (3 days).
- If call ok: schedule tech scoping with Eng Solutions + compile SOW draft (2 weeks).

Misc (brainstorm / rough):
- Potential upsell: embeddings for semantic search across merchant docs; reranking for fraud detection signals.
- Small experiment: turn on KV caching for templated support replies -> measure token delta.

End of doc — keep lean and iterate after first convo.
